</span><span class=3D"status-badge status-badge--alpha">Alpha</span></div><=
time>Mar 9, 2026</time></div><h1 class=3D"product-entry__title">Smasher</h1=
><p class=3D"product-entry__description">Rust pipeline runner that turns DO=
T directed graphs into multi-step AI workflows with streaming, a web dashbo=
ard, and human-in-the-loop gates.</p><div class=3D"product-entry__actions">=
<a href=3D"https://github.com/2389-research/smasher" class=3D"product-entry=
__cta product-entry__cta--secondary" data-tinylytics-event=3D"product.githu=
b" data-tinylytics-event-value=3D"Smasher">GitHub</a>
<a href=3D"https://2389.ai/products/" class=3D"product-entry__back">=E2=86=
=90 All Products</a></div></header><aside class=3D"building-callout"><span =
class=3D"wip-dot" title=3D"Currently building"></span>
<a href=3D"https://github.com/2389-research/smasher" class=3D"building-call=
out__link" data-tinylytics-event=3D"product.building-callout" data-tinylyti=
cs-event-value=3D"Smasher">We're actively building this =E2=86=92</a></asid=
e><div class=3D"product-entry__content prose prose-lg article-content"><p>S=
masher is a Rust reimplementation of <a href=3D"https://github.com/strongdm=
/attractor">strongDM=E2=80=99s attractor</a> =E2=80=94 you define AI workfl=
ows as DOT directed graphs, and smasher executes them node by node. Five cr=
ates handle everything from raw LLM calls up through a web dashboard where =
you can watch pipelines run and answer human gate questions in the browser.=
</p><h2 id=3D"install">Install</h2><div class=3D"highlight"><pre tabindex=
=3D"0" style=3D"color: rgb(248, 248, 242); background-color: rgb(39, 40, 34=
); tab-size: 4; position: relative;"><code class=3D"language-bash" data-lan=
g=3D"bash"><span style=3D"display:flex"><span>git clone https://github.com/=
2389-research/smasher.git
</span></span><span style=3D"display:flex"><span>cd smasher
</span></span><span style=3D"display:flex"><span>cargo build --release
</span></span></code><button class=3D"copy-btn" data-tinylytics-event=3D"co=
de.copy" aria-label=3D"Copy code"><svg width=3D"14" height=3D"14" viewBox=
=3D"0 0 24 24" fill=3D"none" stroke=3D"currentColor" stroke-width=3D"2"><re=
ct x=3D"9" y=3D"9" width=3D"13" height=3D"13" rx=3D"2" ry=3D"2"></rect><pat=
h d=3D"M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path></sv=
g></button></pre></div><p>Set at least one provider key:</p><div class=3D"h=
ighlight"><pre tabindex=3D"0" style=3D"color: rgb(248, 248, 242); backgroun=
d-color: rgb(39, 40, 34); tab-size: 4; position: relative;"><code class=3D"=
language-bash" data-lang=3D"bash"><span style=3D"display:flex"><span>export=
 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY<span style=3D"color:#f92672">=3D</span>sk-ant-...
</span></span><span style=3D"display:flex"><span><span style=3D"color:#7571=
5e"># or OPENAI_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY</span>
</span></span></code><button class=3D"copy-btn" data-tinylytics-event=3D"co=
de.copy" aria-label=3D"Copy code"><svg width=3D"14" height=3D"14" viewBox=
=3D"0 0 24 24" fill=3D"none" stroke=3D"currentColor" stroke-width=3D"2"><re=
ct x=3D"9" y=3D"9" width=3D"13" height=3D"13" rx=3D"2" ry=3D"2"></rect><pat=
h d=3D"M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path></sv=
g></button></pre></div><h2 id=3D"what-it-does">What it does</h2><p><strong>=
DOT-graph pipeline engine.</strong> Nine node types cover the common workfl=
ow patterns: <code>box</code> for LLM agent tasks, <code>diamond</code> for=
 conditionals, <code>oval</code> for human interviews, <code>house</code> f=
or approval gates, <code>hexagon</code> for human interviews, <code>paralle=
logram</code> for tools, and <code>component</code> for parallel fan-out. E=
dges are transitions. Attributes configure behavior. Standard Graphviz DOT =
=E2=80=94 nothing proprietary.</p><p><strong>Multi-provider LLM client.</st=
rong> <code>smasher-llm</code> talks to OpenAI (Responses API), Anthropic (=
Messages API), and Gemini through one unified interface. Streaming, retries=
, and provider-specific quirks are handled at this layer so nothing above i=
t has to care.</p><p><strong>Agent loop with tools.</strong> <code>smasher-=
agent</code> runs a coding agent with six built-in tools =E2=80=94 read, wr=
ite, edit, shell, grep, glob. Steering rules constrain agent behavior per n=
ode. Subagents let you delegate within a pipeline step.</p><p><strong>Web d=
ashboard.</strong> <code>smasher serve</code> starts an HTMX frontend on po=
rt 21541. Live SSE event stream, graph visualization with status overlays, =
and a Q&amp;A interface for human-in-the-loop gates. Submit pipelines from =
the browser or the CLI.</p><p><strong>CLI for everything else.</strong> <co=
de>smasher complete</code> for one-shot prompts, <code>smasher chat</code> =
for an interactive REPL with all six tools, <code>smasher run</code> for he=
adless pipeline execution, plus <code>resume</code>, <code>render</code>, <=
code>ingest</code>, <code>archive</code>, and <code>lint</code>.</p><h2 id=
=3D"how-it-works">How it works</h2><p>Five crates, each depending only on t=
he layers below:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Layer</th><th>Crate</th><th>Role<=
/th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>1</td><td><code>smasher-llm</code></td><td>=
LLM client, provider catalog, request/response types</td></tr><tr><td>2</td=
><td><code>smasher-agent</code></td><td>Agent loop, tool dispatch, steering=
, event system</td></tr><tr><td>3</td><td><code>smasher-attractor</code></t=
d><td>DOT parser (winnow), graph engine, node handlers</td></tr><tr><td>4</=
td><td><code>smasher-cli</code></td><td>CLI binary (clap)</td></tr><tr><td>=
5</td><td><code>smasher-web</code></td><td>Web dashboard (axum + askama + H=
TMX)</td></tr></tbody></table><p>The DOT parser uses winnow to read standar=
d Graphviz digraphs. Node shapes map to handler types. The graph engine wal=
ks the DAG, dispatching each node to its handler, broadcasting events over =
<code>tokio::broadcast</code> for the web dashboard=E2=80=99s SSE stream.</=
p><h2 id=3D"requirements">Requirements</h2><ul><li>Rust 1.85+</li><li>At le=
ast one API key: Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini</li></ul></div><div class=3D"=
product-entry__repo-cta"><a href=3D"https://github.com/2389-research/smashe=
r" class=3D"product-entry__cta product-entry__cta--secondary" aria-label=3D=
